rebirth.opening.human: You woke here, in the ruins of a camp, in a body much like your own. You will need food, rest and company, like anyone here.
rebirth.opening.vampire: You woke here, in the ruins of a camp, as a vampire. The sun will burn you. Blood will feed you, if someone lets you drink.
rebirth.opening.undead: You woke here, in the ruins of a camp, as one of the undead. You will not eat or sleep, but you came back to do something, and without that work you will fade.
rebirth.opening.dryad: You woke here, in the ruins of a camp, as a dryad. The living trees feed you, and one of them is yours. You will never fell a tree.
rebirth.opening.djinn: You woke here, in the ruins of a camp, as a djinn, a spirit of living flame. You will not eat, but you will burn restless until someone strikes a bargain with you.
rebirth.opening.fae: You woke here, in the ruins of a camp, as one of the fae. You cannot lie, and every broken word around you will sting like cold iron.

gift.satchel.name: Bottomless satchel
gift.satchel.summary: A store only you can reach: nothing in it spoils, no thief or rot ever reaches it, and the ration policy does not count it.
gift.satchel.grows: It grows each time a meal from it lifts someone out of starving.
gift.fortunes_favourite.name: Fortune's favourite
gift.fortunes_favourite.summary: Harm meant for you finds someone near you instead.
gift.fortunes_favourite.grows: It grows each time harm turns from you.
gift.fortunes_favourite.stage1: turns harm on whoever stands beside you
gift.fortunes_favourite.stage2: turns harm on anyone within two paces
gift.fortunes_favourite.stage3: turns harm within two paces, and once a season death passes you by
gift.familiar_faces.name: Familiar faces
gift.familiar_faces.summary: Those close to you in a future that never came feel they have known you for years.
gift.familiar_faces.grows: It grows each time a familiar face becomes your friend, or does you a kindness, soon after you come back.
gift.familiar_faces.stage1: they keep a quarter of what they felt
gift.familiar_faces.stage2: they keep two fifths of what they felt
gift.familiar_faces.stage3: they keep three fifths of what they felt
gift_seen.seen: Others can see it at work.
gift_seen.loud: Everyone near can see it at work.
